Record Class CorsPolicy

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
forj.http.middleware.CorsPolicy
Record Components:
allOrigins - every origin is allowed (origins is then ignored)
origins - the allowed origins, compared exactly (https://app.example.com)
methods - methods a preflight allows
headers - request headers a preflight allows; empty allows whatever is asked for
exposed - response headers scripts may read
credentials - whether cookies and auth headers may be sent; the response then names the origin instead of *, as browsers require
maxAge - how long a browser may cache a preflight answer
public record CorsPolicy(boolean allOrigins, Set<String> origins, Set<Method> methods, Set<String> headers, Set<String> exposed, boolean credentials, Duration maxAge) extends Record
Which cross-origin requests browsers may make, for Middlewares.cors(CorsPolicy, Applicative). Start from anyOrigin() or origins, then narrow with the with* methods.
